disclaimer: Licensure rules, English test thresholds, and regulatory fees change periodically. Always confirm directly on the official regulatory council or nursing board portal linked in each country guide before paying exam fees.

countries.council: Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC) & UHPAB (formerly UNMEB)
countries.examRequired: UHPAB / UNMEB Certificate or Diploma Theory + Practical & OSCE
countries.languageTest: English instruction verified via accredited Ugandan training institution
countries.summary: Complete guide to becoming an Enrolled Nurse/Midwife or Registered Nurse/Midwife in Uganda: UHPAB assessments, UNMC internship/registration, and CPD renewal.
steps: Complete O-Level (UCE) or A-Level (UACE) entry requirements in Biology, Chemistry, Physics/Math, and English.
Enroll in an accredited nursing or midwifery school indexed with UHPAB (formerly UNMEB) and UNMC.
Pass semester theory papers (Section A MCQs, Section B Short Essays, Section C Long Scenarios) plus ward practicals & OSCE.
Apply via the UNMC Digital Portal for Enrolment/Registration Certificate and Annual Practicing License (APL).
Maintain active CPD points and follow Uganda Clinical Guidelines 2023 in clinical practice.
documents: UACE / UCE Academic Transcripts & School Indexing Card
UHPAB / UNMEB Final Pass Slip & Academic Transcript
Logbook Completion & Clinical Preceptor Sign-off
National ID / Passport & Current UNMC APL Receipt

countries.summary: Registration steps for Kenya-trained KRCHN/BSN nurses and foreign-trained East African nurses seeking Nursing Council of Kenya licensure.
steps: Verify secondary school KCSE C (Plain) or international equivalence through Kenya National Qualifications Authority (KNQA).
Create an NCK Online Portal profile and submit foreign training syllabus transcripts plus home country Good Standing verification.
Undergo NCK Credentials & Clinical Placement evaluation if trained outside Kenya.
Pass the Computer-Based NCK Licensure Examination covering Medical-Surgical, Midwifery, Community Health, Psychiatry & Paediatrics.
Apply for NCK Retention / Annual Practice License.
documents: Nursing Diploma/Degree Transcript + Hourly Curriculum Breakdown
Home Council License (e.g., UNMC) & Certificate of Good Standing
KNQA Foreign Qualification Equated Letter
Valid Passport, Clearance Certificate & Passport Photos

countries.summary: Overview of Certificate, Diploma & BScN nursing registration with Tanzania Nursing and Midwifery Council including East African Community mutual recognition checks.
steps: Authenticate nursing qualifications through TCU/NACTVET foreign award recognition.
Register on the TNMC Online Information System (TNMC-OIS) and upload training transcripts + Good Standing letter.
Complete any supervised adaptation clinical hours prescribed by TNMC.
Sit and pass the semi-annual TNMC National Nursing & Midwifery Licensing Examination.
Collect TNMC Practicing Certificate prior to hospital deployment.
documents: NACTVET / TCU Foreign Award Equivalence Certificate
Official Nursing Transcripts & Clinical Log Summary
Current Home Regulatory License & Good Standing Verification
Work/Residence Permit (for non-citizens)

countries.examRequired: NMC Test of Competence (Part 1 Computer-Based Test + Part 2 OSCE)
countries.languageTest: IELTS Academic 7.0 (6.5 Writing ok) OR OET Grade B (C+ Writing ok) OR SIFE/Employer route
countries.timeline: 4–9 Months (Language Test -> CBT -> UK OSCE -> PIN)
countries.summary: Fastest international route for Ugandan & African Registered Nurses (Adult, Mental Health, Children's, Midwifery) joining the UK NHS via NMC CBT and practical OSCE.
steps: Hold active home registration (e.g., UNMC Registered Nurse / Midwife + Certificate/Diploma/BScN qualification).
Pass English requirement (OET B/C+ or IELTS Academic 7.0 overall — clubbing two sittings within 12 months permitted).
Complete NMC Online Eligibility Application and verify UNMC registration & employer/health character declarations.
Book and pass NMC Part 1 CBT (Numeracy drug calculations 15 Qs + Clinical 100 Qs) at an approved Pearson VUE centre (Kampala/Nairobi).
Obtain UK Health & Care Worker Visa sponsorship, pass the Part 2 Practical OSCE (APIE care stations + clinical skills), and receive your NMC PIN.
documents: OET or IELTS Certificate Meeting NMC Thresholds
Active UNMC Registration & Good Standing sent directly to NMC
Academic Nursing Transcripts & Employer Reference (3 years check)
Police Clearance & Tuberculosis Screening Certificate (UKVI)

countries.council: State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN) & CGFNS International
countries.examRequired: Next Generation NCLEX-RN (NGN Case Studies & CAT Exam)
countries.languageTest: IELTS Academic 6.5 (Speaking 7.0) or TOEFL iBT or PTE (waivers vary by training country)
countries.summary: Complete US pathway for foreign-educated nurses: CGFNS Credentials Evaluation Service (CES), State Board ATT authorization, NextGen NCLEX-RN, and VisaScreen.
steps: Select a target US State Board of Nursing (e.g., New York NYSED, Texas, Florida, Illinois) and check whether CGFNS Certification/CES is mandated.
Have your nursing college & UNMC submit transcripts and license verification straight to CGFNS CES / ERES.
Receive Authorization to Test (ATT) from the State Board + Pearson VUE and pass the adaptive Next Generation NCLEX-RN (70–145 Qs including unfolding clinical case studies).
Pass VisaScreen (ICHP) English & credential check before EB-3 / employment green-card consular interview.
documents: CGFNS CES Professional Course-by-Course Report
Official Nursing School Breakdown (Med-Surg, Paeds, Maternity, Psych Theory & Clinical Hours)
Home Council License Verification & VisaScreen Certificate
English Proficiency Score (IELTS / OET / TOEFL as required by state/VisaScreen)

countries.council: NNAS + Provincial Regulator (CNO Ontario, BCCNM, CRNA Alberta)
countries.languageTest: CELBAN or IELTS Academic (Writing 7.0 / Reading 6.5 / Listening 7.5 / Speaking 7.0)
countries.timeline: 8–16 Months (NNAS Advisory Report -> Provincial Assessment -> NCLEX-RN)
countries.summary: Pathway for international RN/LPN applicants entering Canada via NNAS credential evaluation, provincial English/jurisprudence checks, and NCLEX-RN.
steps: Open an NNAS (National Nursing Assessment Service) profile selecting target province (e.g. Ontario CNO, Alberta CRNA, British Columbia BCCNM).
Submit notarized ID, school curriculum forms, UNMC registration verification, and last 3–5 years nursing practice forms.
Complete provincial language proficiency + jurisprudence exam once NNAS issues the Advisory Report.
Complete any Supervised Practice Experience (SPEP) or bridging course if gap identified, then pass NCLEX-RN.
documents: NNAS Advisory Report
Official Employment Verification Forms (Safe Practice Hours)
CELBAN / IELTS / OET Results
Police Vulnerable Sector Check

countries.council: AHPRA / Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA)
countries.examRequired: Outcome-Based Assessment (OBA): NCLEX-RN MCQ + Australian Practical OSCE
countries.languageTest: IELTS 7.0 all bands OR OET Grade B all bands OR PTE 65 all bands
countries.timeline: 6–14 Months (IQNM Self-Check -> OBA NCLEX -> OSCE -> AHPRA Registration)
countries.summary: How overseas qualified Registered Nurses (Stream B IQNM) qualify in Australia using AHPRA's Outcome-Based Assessment (NCLEX-RN + Adelaide OSCE).
steps: Complete AHPRA's online IQNM Self-Check to determine qualification stream (most African diplomas/degrees without substantial US/UK equivalence enter Stream B OBA).
Submit identity, qualifications, and ANMAC / AHPRA portfolio verification plus English test scores (IELTS 7.0 / OET B).
Pass Stage 1 OBA (NCLEX-RN multiple-choice computer exam).
Pass Stage 2 OBA (Clinical OSCE assessing safe Australian clinical practice & cultural safety), then apply for AHPRA registration.
documents: IELTS 7.0 / OET B / PTE Academic 65 Result
Verified Qualification & Home Nursing Board Good Standing
Criminal History Check (International)
NCLEX-RN + AHPRA OSCE Pass Confirmation

countries.council: DHA (Dubai), DOH (Abu Dhabi), MOHAP & SCFHS (Saudi Arabia)
countries.examRequired: Prometric CBT Nursing Licensing Exam (DHA / MOH / SCFHS)
countries.languageTest: English nursing curriculum & DataFlow Primary Source Verification (PSV)
countries.timeline: 2–5 Months (DataFlow PSV -> Prometric Exam -> Eligibility Letter)
countries.summary: Fast tax-free Middle East pathway for Registered Nurses with >= 2 years hospital experience via DataFlow Primary Source Verification and Prometric exam.
steps: Confirm eligibility under PQR rules (typically Recognized Nursing Diploma/BScN + valid Home License + minimum 2 years continuous post-registration bedside experience).
Submit documents to DataFlow Primary Source Verification (PSV) — school degree, UNMC license, and hospital experience letters.
Book and pass the Prometric CBT exam (~100–150 NCLEX-style MCQs on Med-Surg, Maternal, Paediatrics, Critical Care & Ethics).
Obtain Eligibility Letter and convert to active professional license upon signed hospital offer.
documents: Minimum 2 Years Post-Registration Clinical Experience Letters
Active Home License (e.g. UNMC) + Certificate of Good Standing
DataFlow PSV Clear Report
Prometric Exam Pass Report & Valid Passport
